patrons.title: Founding Scientific Patrons
patrons.subtitle: Help establish enduring scientific capacity for the researchers who follow.
patrons.description: Scientific patronage at Institute Lux Consilio supports foundational inquiry, mathematical inheritance and the development of Concordia.
intro: The opportunity for founding scientific patrons is to participate in the formative development of a scientific environment whose value extends through future discoveries. Concordia preserves and connects mathematical constructions, scientific results, established obstructions and research histories so they can participate in subsequent inquiry.

Individuals and family foundations are invited to discuss philanthropic support for this work. Sustained support can help establish the continuity required for research infrastructure, independent examination and qualified participation across disciplines.

ways.title: Flexible institutional support
ways.text: Support the Institute’s charitable scientific and educational work, including the continuity of foundational research, mathematical infrastructure and scholarly communication.

ways.title: Scientific infrastructure
ways.text: Discuss support for the Formal World, Runtime development, research computing, reproducibility and the maintenance of mathematical sources.

ways.title: Independent examination
ways.text: Help make specialist review, mathematical reconstruction and qualified scholarly engagement possible.

ways.title: Future researcher participation
ways.text: Discuss support for onboarding, computational resources and the development of research fellowships as the necessary program arrangements are established.

ways.title: Multi-year patronage
ways.text: Explore a sustained philanthropic commitment aligned with the Institute’s actual development milestones, resources and charitable mission.

ways.title: Project-specific support
ways.text: Discuss a defined scientific or infrastructure objective with an agreed scope, appropriate oversight and reporting arrangements.

principles: Scientific conclusions remain governed by mathematical and empirical evidence. A contribution creates no scientific authority, ownership of research results or entitlement to restricted sources.

Recognition, when appropriate and agreed, may acknowledge philanthropic participation. Donor names are used only with permission; reporting and correspondence arrangements are discussed before acceptance.

Gift purpose, restrictions, reporting and any relevant conflicts are evaluated through appropriate institutional arrangements. ILC’s charitable activities are distinct from Fieldflux Biosystems’ commercial activities.

partnerships.title: Institutional and Technology Partnerships
partnerships.subtitle: Extend the reach of scientific inquiry through shared expertise, infrastructure and questions.
partnerships.description: Explore research, institutional, philanthropic and technology partnerships with Institute Lux Consilio.
intro: Concordia is being developed as scientific infrastructure for cumulative mathematical research and governed human–AI inquiry. Institutions can help broaden this capability through research participation, technical expertise, computational resources, independent verification and appropriately structured philanthropic support.
A partnership begins with a scientific or infrastructural objective. The parties identify the relevant source materials, responsibilities, anticipated outcomes and appropriate evidence of progress.

ways.title: Universities and research institutes
ways.text: Joint investigations, specialist examination, formal mathematical collaboration and qualified researcher participation.

ways.title: Scientific and philanthropic foundations
ways.text: Research grants, infrastructure development, independent verification and the future participation of researchers.

ways.title: AI research organizations
ways.text: Source-grounded mathematical reasoning, long-horizon research, scientific evidence qualification and governed human–AI collaboration.

ways.title: Computational infrastructure partners
ways.text: Computing credits, model access, storage, reproducible environments and formal verification resources.

ways.title: Measurement and experimental institutions
ways.text: Observation theory, measurement sufficiency, physical modeling and independent empirical investigation.

ways.title: Educational organizations
ways.text: Inquiry-driven mathematical education, scholarly mentorship and future fellowship or graduate research opportunities.

principles: Identify a scientific question or infrastructure need, the relevant research program, and the type of contribution.
Agree upon scientific methods, evidence requirements, permitted access, security, publication, attribution, data and intellectual property arrangements as appropriate.
Assess results at their actual mathematical or empirical scope. Any ongoing relationship remains subject to institutional review and documented responsibilities.
